note: State forest family campground in five loops in mixed woods east of Mauthe Lake: sites 101-110 and 215-223 are mostly sunny with a view over the lake's reed fringe, the 500s lie farther east (508-524 and 539-558 shaded), and the 51 electric sites are in the 100s, 200s and 400s. The beach, concession and kayak rentals are at the lake's south end. Closed from Sept. 6, 2027 through spring 2028 for driveway resurfacing and site improvements (DNR, posted 2026-09-28). The equestrian (New Prospect) and group (Greenbush) camps are separate facilities. --Claude
